newsitem.title: UK: Moody's rates two RG Interest Plus funds AAA.
newsitem.headline: Moody's rates two RG Interest Plus funds AAA.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said on Thursday it assigned an AAA rating to two subfunds of the RG Interest Plus Funds (the Fund) umbrella.
The two subfunds are RG Money Plus Fund NLG and RG Bond Plus Fund NLG, Moody's said.
The Fund is advised in Rotterdam by Robeco Investor Services B.V., part of the Robeco Group, Moody's said in a statement.
Moody's said that the ratings reflect the fund advisor's focus on investment quality, including the Funds' ability to provide a high level of liquidity to meet redemption needs.
Moody's noted that the Robeco Group is an experienced asset manager with the equivalent of more than $46 billion in funds under management.

In addition, the strong control environment and oversight capabilities of Robeco, as well as the Funds' administrator and custodian, Citibank (Luxembourg) S.A. were factors contributing to the AAA fund rating, Moody's said.
